none: PAS NLM-39EB87: Roman Coin: Copy Denarius from Muckton
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy with thick silver coating. Coin. Possibly copy Denarius, possibly Severan period (193-211), Reece period 10. A crescentic chip has been lost from the edge of the coin. Obverse description: Bust right. Traces of silver appear as if peeled back from surface of flan. Obverse inscription: [--]C[--]V[--]S A[--]. Reverse description: Possibly an angular object, perhaps an altar; otherwise…
